description: The Pipe Vibration research team publishes 382 triaxial acceleration signals measured on a pipe conveying cold water. Measurements cover eighty controlled flow rates, with three to six repetitions at each setting and microsecond timestamps. OSF identifies a public project created in 2021, and DataCite records CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The site-specific laboratory signals can calibrate flow-induced vibration simulations or compare methods for inferring flow from pipe-wall motion. Repository metadata gives a minimum flow of 6.25 litres per hour, while the article states 25; both report a maximum of 20,000. This discrepancy and the unknown file formats remain unresolved. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
